body:
Weekly QA sync from GF. Items relevant to GA:

1. RISK: save-load-audit.test.js still failing (pre-existing). GA should add try/catch around importScores() and validate data.version field before assigning. See docs/agents/gf-peer-risk-brief-template.md for brief format.

2. NEW: dad-view-isolation.test.js (15/15 pass) now guards _dadMode flag + _dadScores isolation. If you touch dadModeInit() or getScores(), re-run this suite.

3. NEW: export-import-qa.test.js (34/34 pass) validates exportScores() schema. If export format changes, update tests/kai-scores-*.json fixture files.

4. Release readiness gate: node tests/release-readiness-check.js must pass 19/19 before any motor-city-math push. Currently green.

5. Regression baseline updated to 35/42. Run node tests/regression-replay.js to verify no regression after any code change.
subject: [GF Weekly Sync] QA notes for GA — 2026-02-23
